name: sfxmint
description: Free CC0 sound effects for apps and games: find a sound by event, set or description and download it into the project.

interface.shortDescription: Free CC0 sound effects for apps and games.
interface.longDescription: Finds sound effects in the SFXMint library by game or app event, as a matching set, or by description, and downloads the MP3 or WAV files into the project with a SOUNDS.md record. Search and downloads need no API key; every sound is CC0 and AI-generated.
defaultPrompt: Use SFXMint to add button click and success sounds to this app.
Use SFXMint to find a sound set for this platformer: jump, coin, hit and game over.
Use SFXMint to find a soft notification chime under one second.
